scope: Owner-requested map stair access, usable cable-car boarding/braking and centred controlled-player camera. Owner source art assets retained.

fixes.stairs: Closed overlapping timber risers replace floating treads in buildings, harbour, mid/summit stations and coaster access; thick buried-toe building ramps, one walking collider per flight.
fixes.valleyPlatform: Previous deck top was 8.278866 m while route platform was 8 m. Deck now meets the route at 8 m.
fixes.cabin: Open end portals, interior foot anchors above the floor, eight-second station stops, F boarding/exiting, H seat changes.
fixes.exit: Docked inside passengers require an unobstructed supporting platform spot; both inside seats at all three stations tested. Roof/in-flight jump rules retained.
fixes.brake: Actual visible grip is the F/hitscan target; valley/summit pedestals moved clear of docking hulls, with matching solid colliders. Prompt uses actual eye height and obstruction checks. Real events animate the closest lever and show translated two-second-stop feedback.
fixes.camera: Human shoulder offset zero. Follow springs carry the controlled body displacement; vehicle interpolation precedes camera/occupants. Actual followed pivot stays in the centre during orbit/translation. No free camera replacement.
fixes.delayedFeedback: A brake event whose entire timer elapsed during a GPU stall still shows one pulled-handle render, then returns to frozen rest.

targetedChecks: All building stairs ascended/descended through lower/upper landings in the real Rapier world
All three station approaches walked up/down without jumping
Normal F boarding and both inside-seat exits at every station
F on every actual station lever stops both moving cabins and allows resumption
Real lever hitscan plus rearward/short-ray rejection and existing roof-bracing checks
Camera centre across yaw/zoom and metre-scale vehicle pose jumps; geometric doorway clearance
Visible handle timer and delayed-render feedback; closed stair riser geometry

renderBudget.walkingColliders: Still one slab per stair flight; three small pedestal boxes added
renderBudget.note: Cloud Chromium software rendering verifies behavior and framing; its FPS is not a native GPU benchmark.

validation.coverage: Complete script/server suites and complete client suite; client rerun after updating the obsolete left-foreground camera contract to centre plus real wall retraction. No timeout increases.
validation.browser: Ordinary F boarding, real brake events and visible 1.35 rad lever pull, moving cabin kept in frame, horizontal player projection 0.49999972, zero console errors.
validation.soak: 15 simulated minutes, 2 ticket round endings and 2 resets
